extra_test = '''
  test "manages memberships for suspended staff, handles combined filter errors, and returns 404 on malformed IDs" do
    signup_and_verify!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme", admin_name: "Jo", email: "jo@acme.test")
    owner_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test")["session"]["token"]

    sam_data = invite_and_accept!(admin_token: owner_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent", name: "Sam")
    sam_id = sam_data[:user]["id"]

    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "Billing" } }, headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
    billing_id = json_body["group"]["id"]
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "Support" } }, headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
    support_id = json_body["group"]["id"]
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "Ops" } }, headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
    ops_id = json_body["group"]["id"]

    post "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_membership: { group_id: billing_id, user_id: sam_id, default: true } }, headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
    m_billing = json_body["group_membership"]["id"]
    post "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_membership: { group_id: support_id, user_id: sam_id, default: false } }, headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
    m_support = json_body["group_membership"]["id"]

    # Suspend Sam -> memberships kept, admin can still manage memberships for later
    patch "/api/v1/users/#{sam_id}", params: { user: { suspended: true } }, headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    post "/api/v1/group_memberships", params: { group_membership: { group_id: ops_id, user_id: sam_id, default: true } }, headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :created
    m_ops = json_body["group_membership"]["id"]
    assert_equal true, json_body["group_membership"]["default"]

    # Deleting Ops while Sam is suspended promotes Billing (lowest remaining ID) to default
    delete "/api/v1/groups/#{ops_id}", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
    assert_response :no_content

    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?user_id=#{sam_id}", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ m_billing, m_support ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["id"] }
    assert_equal [ true, false ], json_body["group_memberships"].map { |m| m["default"] }

    # make_default while suspended
    put "/api/v1/group_memberships/#{m_support}/make_default", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal true, json_body["group_membership"]["default"]

    # Combined invalid filters collect both errors
    get "/api/v1/group_memberships?group_id=bad&user_id=0", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json_body["errors"]["group_id"].present?
    assert json_body["errors"]["user_id"].present?

    # Malformed / out-of-range IDs return 404 JSON
    [
      [ :get, "/api/v1/groups/not-an-id" ],
      [ :get, "/api/v1/groups/99999999999999999999999" ],
      [ :patch, "/api/v1/groups/not-an-id" ],
      [ :delete, "/api/v1/groups/99999999999999999999999" ],
      [ :get, "/api/v1/group_memberships/not-an-id" ],
      [ :put, "/api/v1/group_memberships/99999999999999999999999/make_default" ],
      [ :delete, "/api/v1/group_memberships/not-an-id" ]
    ].each do |method, path|
      send(method, path, headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json)
      assert_response :not_found, "Expected 404 for #{method.upcase} #{path}"
      assert_equal "Not found", json_body["error"]
    end
  end
end
'''

assert content.endswith("end\n")
content = content[:-4] + extra_test
with open("test/integration/api/v1/groups_and_memberships_test.rb", "w") as f:

extra_ticket_test = '''
  test "email-origin ticket group routing delivers staff replies only on valid updates" do
    signup_and_verify!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme", admin_name: "Jo", email: "jo@acme.test")
    jo_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test")["session"]["token"]
    sam_data = invite_and_accept!(admin_token: jo_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent", name: "Sam")
    sam_id = sam_data[:user]["id"]

    acme = Account.find_by!(subdomain: "acme")
    customer = acme.users.create!(name: "Avery", email: "avery@example.test", password: "my-customer-password", role: "customer")
    email_ticket = acme.tickets.create!(requester: customer, subject: "Email inquiry", channel: Ticket::EMAIL)

    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "Billing" } }, headers: account_headers("acme", token: jo_token), as: :json
    billing_id = json_body["group"]["id"]
    post "/api/v1/groups", params: { group: { name: "Support" } }, headers: account_headers("acme", token: jo_token), as: :json
    support_id = json_body["group"]["id"]

      params: { group_membership: { group_id: billing_id, user_id: sam_id, default: true } },
      headers: account_headers("acme", token: jo_token),
      as: :json

    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear

    # Invalid group + assignee + public comment -> 422, no email delivered
    patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{email_ticket.id}",

      as: :json
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert_equal 0, ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size

    # Valid assignment to Sam (uses default Billing) + public comment -> 200, email delivered

    assert_response :ok

end

The standard CRUD routes are present for both groups and group memberships, including `PATCH` for group names. All the proper HTTP methods are in place for the list, detail, create, update and delete routes, and I've ensured that the API returns the correct HTTP status codes in each case.

Listing groups and memberships by ID ascending is done with `order(id: :asc)` on both the `Group` and `GroupMembership` models. Simple and direct.

Default membership selection is handled with a `PUT /api/v1/group_memberships/:id/make_default` route, admin-only, returning 200 OK. The "one default per staff member" rule is enforced at the model, controller, and DB level, using a partial unique index. Automatic default selection on membership deletion (or removal of group) is implemented, too.

Filtering memberships by `group_id` and `user_id` is supported via the appropriate `GET` route with those parameters. I've validated those parameters too.

Now, for ticket enhancements: Ticket serialization includes `group_id` and `group: { id, name }`. Staff can filter the inbox by group using `GET /api/v1/tickets?group_id=<id>` and `GET /api/v1/tickets?group_id=unassigned`, which is case-insensitive. And this is not exposed on the customer routes.

The ticket model validation ensures that an assigned person belongs to the ticket's group. Assigning to an ungrouped ticket defaults to the assignee's default group. Moving a ticket to another group clears the assignee if they don't belong to the new group. Clearing the assignee leaves the group, while explicitly clearing the group also clears the assignee. Group and membership deletion cleans up ticket assignments as requested: Group deletion clears both `group_id` and `assignee_id`. Membership deletion clears `assignee_id` only for tickets in that specific group-user pair, and I make sure `customer_updated_at` isn't touched in either case.

Finally, user suspension keeps memberships intact while clearing ticket assignments, leaving the ticket's `group_id` untouched.

Alright, I'm confident. Now, let's just inspect the files changed/created, run `git status` to ensure a clean working directory, make sure the development database is up-to-date and clean, and run all tests one last time. We should be good to go.
